title: Senior Solutions Architect
description_html:
Airbyte is the data and action layer for AI agents. We give agents fast, accurate, authenticated access to business data across hundreds of sources, so they can discover the entities that matter, reason over real-time context, and take action in the systems they read from, not just observe them.



We started as the open-source standard for data movement and proved the economics of data integration at scale: hundreds of connectors, thousands of companies, and, since 2020, have raised $181M from leading investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator. As our CEO Michel Tricot puts it, "the last ten years were all about structured data. The future is all about context." We're now building that context infrastructure for production-grade agents on the same open foundation, as agents become the primary consumers of enterprise data.



Our mission is unchanged: make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. That everyone now includes AI agents.

 


THE ROLE:

As an Airbyte Senior Solutions Architect, you will have a unique opportunity to elevate your career and make an immediate impact in the rapidly growing data infrastructure sector. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in helping customers implement and adopt our products while serving as their advocate within the company. This includes collaborating with Go-to-Market (GTM), Product, and Engineering teams to refine and enhance the onboarding, implementation, and growth experiences for enterprise customers. You will also work closely with cross-functional teams to support both sales and post-sales efforts, driving improved qualification, faster deal cycles, and higher levels of customer satisfaction and retention. Joining us at this stage means you’ll be on the ground floor of a rapidly expanding Series B startup, with significant opportunities for professional growth and advancement.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Technical Implementation

 - Lead and execute impactful customer technical projects, including the implementation and deployment of Airbyte solutions, while ensuring alignment with client requirements and industry best practices.

 - Guide customers throughout their customer journey by leveraging your technical expertise and stepping in with hands-on support when needed.

 - Deep Kubernetes expertise, including hands-on troubleshooting of workloads, pods, networking, storage, and resource management in production.

 - Deep understanding of database technologies, including SQL, CDC (Change Data Capture), database replication, and data synchronization concepts, with the ability to troubleshoot complex data movement issues.

 - Strong knowledge of REST APIs, including HTTP methods, authentication (OAuth, API keys, JWT), webhooks, and JSON, with the ability to troubleshoot complex integration issues.

 - Advise customers on integrating LLM-based tooling into their existing data infrastructure alongside Airbyte connectors.



Client Engagement

 - Work directly with clients’ technical teams to understand their needs and tailor solutions accordingly.

 - Managing technical success by collaborating with Airbyte’s technical support, Product, and Engineering teams to address issues and deliver new features.

 - Help clients evaluate and adopt AI agent frameworks to build autonomous data agents that leverage Airbyte as a data source.



Cross-Department Collaboration

 - Collaborate with Sales to identify and drive potential growth opportunities with customers.

 - Act as the internal source of truth for customer technical requirements, expectations, and needed functionalities.

 - Partner with Product and Engineering teams to surface customer needs, influencing the roadmap.



Advocacy and Evangelism

 - Demonstrate the use and best practices of Airbyte’s offering to clients and at industry events.

 - Serve as a brand ambassador promoting the organization’s mission and fostering relationships with key stakeholders.

 - Evangelize best practices for building AI-ready data stacks

 - Create and deliver technical content (blog posts, demos, conference talks) showcasing how Airbyte enables modern AI architectures.

 


WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

 - 6+ years of experience in a customer facing technical role, such as resident solutions architect, professional services engineer, or consulting role.

 - 2+ years of experience in a startup environment, ideally in modern data infrastructure, including cloud applications, databases, ELT tools, data warehouses or related fields (startup implementation experience is a bonus).

 - Hands-on experience with one or more AI frameworks

 - Exposure to AI agent frameworks and prompt engineering best practices is a strong plus.

 - Proven track record of supporting products that directly impact business productivity.

 - Exceptional customer orientation with a focus on delivering seamless onboarding and ongoing technical success.

 - Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.

 
 


LOCATION:

 - Remote from New York City, supporting East Coast Timezone




WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT AIRBYTE:

At Airbyte, we believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and empowered to grow. Our market-leading Total Rewards package is designed to help you thrive professionally and personally. Our benefits and perks include:

 - Flexible PTO with a culture that encourages at least 25 days off annually

 - 16 weeks fully paid parental leave for all parents

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents

 - 401(k) retirement plan

 - Professional development budget, conference sponsorship, and book reimbursement

 - Commuter benefits and monthly internet reimbursement

 - Breakfast and lunch in our San Francisco office

 - A collaborative, in-person culture focused on learning, growth, and impact



If you find this role exciting, we encourage you to apply even if you think you don’t meet all of the requirements!



We are not accepting agency submissions or recruiting firm support for this role. Unsolicited resumes will not be considered.



Airbyte is an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, familial status, domestic violence victim status, veteran or military status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.



Airbyte is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodations due to a disability.
$159,375 – $255,000 • Offers Equity • Offers Commission • Multiple Ranges

title: Sr. Lead Platform Engineer
description_html: Sr. Lead Platform Engineer      The ideal candidate will work with senior leaders to deliver results across a broad portfolio of initiatives and is comfortable thinking strategically.  This leader will  identify opportunities and leverage the team to translate them into live solutions.        We are seeking a candidate with a strong track record of delivering successful and productive experiences in a broad collaboration ecosystem.  You will be delivering sophisticated capabilities across many use cases within a dynamic array of business and technology constraints.         In this role you will bring together key stakeholders across product, tech, risk, cyber, and lines of business together to drive strategy and execute on high priority, strategic initiatives. You will be able to deliver outsized and measurable outcomes by defining and guiding objectives, roadmaps, cross organization collaboration, progress and technical requirements for our Teams.  This will require ability to communicate across technical and non-technical stakeholders and manage strategic initiatives with a deep focus on execution and follow-through, accountability and results.               Responsibilities:     Design, document, and maintain the enterprise-wide Google Workspace Collaboration Platform      Design, document, and maintain the enterprise-wide Microsoft M365 Collaboration Platform      Partner with Product and Risk stakeholders to translate business objectives and risk tolerance into platform configurations, security practices, and data handling policies.      Partner with Access team on the IAM strategy for Google Workspace and/or M365, including multi-factor authentication, SSO integration, and context-aware access policies.      Partner with key stakeholders to architect, implement, and manage a robust content management program for Google Drive to prevent unauthorized sharing of sensitive data.      Maintain and execute lifecycle-based governance processes for third-party applications accessing Workspace data, including risk assessments and security audits.      Ensure the Google Workspace platform meets or exceeds regulatory and legal framework requirements through proper configuration, operation, and auditing.      Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, and HR to apply Google Vault data retention, eDiscovery, and legal holds correctly.      Identify automation opportunities for repetitive administrative tasks, partnering with the K&P SWE team where appropriate.      Provide prompt and effective technical support to users, troubleshooting issues and answering questions        Monitor system performance, security, and data integrity, taking proactive measures to address potential problems      Stay up-to-date with the latest Google Workspace features and best practices, implementing updates and improvements as needed      Develop and maintain clear documentation and training materials for users      Focus on building and maintaining the underlying operational aspects of the platform including remediating vulnerabilities      Monitor platform support Slack channels and address customer questions and issues      Work closely with the Architecture team to align the platforms to latest architecture and configuration      Encourage innovation, automation, implementation of cutting-edge technologies, inclusion, outside-of-the-box thinking, teamwork, self-organization and diversity to a legacy process      Develop, and utilize best practices to enhance the overall user experience of the platform      Collaborate with the Software Engineers to ensure software works seamlessly on the platforms      Work with product owners to understand desired application capabilities and testing scenarios      Continuously improve platform engineering practices and proactively identify risks and execute strategies that eliminate or mitigate those risks      Work within and across Agile teams to design, develop, test, implement and support technical solutions across a full-stack of development tools and technologies      Bring a passion to stay on top of tech trends, experiment with and learn new technologies, participate in internal & external technology communities, and mentor other members of the engineering community      Encourage innovation, implementation of cutting-edge technologies, inclusion, outside-of-the-box thinking, teamwork, self-organization and diversity      Directly and indirectly lead a teams of engineers and people leaders to build strategy for each platform and drive being Well Managed, the core goal at Capital One      Utilize scripting languages like Python, Bash, and others.           We want you if you are:      Intellectually Curious. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges.      Communicator & Influencer. You’re comfortable influencing a group of executives as well as communicating clearly to partners. You can be open to different communication styles and listen carefully to diverse sets of ideas.      Do-er. You’re biased toward action, and are willing to make commitments and trade-offs with other leaders to remove impediments for your team.       Learner. You have an appetite to learn new things or new technologies all while exhibiting humbleness when exploring unknown technologies.      Team Player. You enjoy working with diverse people and driving the team toward a common goal. You are also able to coach others and be a mentor.       Basic Qualifications:       Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.      At least 6 years of cumulative experience in enterprise information technology, systems engineering, or cybersecurity roles.      At least 4 years of direct, hands-on experience architecting, administering, and securing a large-scale (1,000+ user) Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 collaboration environment.      Hands-on experience deploying, configuring, or managing services across SaaS, IaaS, and PaaS cloud environments.        Preferred Qualifications:       Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, an MBA with a technology focus, or equivalent practical experience.      Current Google Certified - Associate Google Workspace Administrator certification is strongly preferred.      Acknowledged expertise with the content and objectives of the retired Professional Google Workspace Administrator certification is also highly valued as an indicator of advanced experience.      6+ years of experience administering Google Workspace or a similar enterprise productivity suite or 6+ years of experience administering Microsoft M365 or a similar enterprise productivity suite      Experience with Google GenAI / LLM platforms and other Agentic or SaaS AI capabilities      6+ years of experience using build and deployment tools (Jenkins, GitHub, or Artifactory)      4 + years of experience in scripting (Powershell, Python, Bash)      4+ years of experience working with Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform, Cloudformation, CDK, or others.      2+ year of experience in the financial or tech industry        At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization, or offer any immigration related support for this position (i.e. H1B, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, J-1, TN, or another type of work authorization).
